notes.note: This makes it two in the 50s now in the last three games for Petracca which is a real concern. He had 19 touches but his efficiency was just 63%. He isn't having the impact we need for big scoring.

Petracca had his best score for since their bye from his 28 disposals. He did have a huge 19 contested possessions and he also led the team with 7 clearances. This is the Trac we are far more used to and hopefully he keeps this up.
Just 35 points after quarter time for Petracca in his worst output of the season. His 17 disposals came at just 47% efficiency.

Petracca took a bit to get going but finished with the most contested possessions in the game with 19 as well as 31 disposals (22 handballs). His first 100+ since the bye and hopefully he can elevate from here.

Petracca had the tag from Mullin as expected and it did hold his scoring well down in the first half. He moved up forward after half time and this helped break that tag and eh was able to get more of the footy and a goal.

Petracca was one of the easiest trade ins for those that had Flanders but he wasn't able to produce the high numbers we were accustomed to with his 20 disposals yielding his lowest score of the season so far.
This was Petracca's best game in the last three and will make him a hot trade in off the byes. His BE is at 113 and will mean you could bring him in straight after his bye.
Petracca led the Suns with 15 contested possessions and 9 clearances. If his efficiency was up from the 51% for his 27 disposals he could have got to 100
Petracca was tagged by Stocker this week and held to just his second score under 100 for the season. He had the 23 disposals but only 9 were by foot. Nothing to be concerned about here.
Petracca was the best for the Suns as his injury issues are behind him now. 29 disposals with 6 clearances and a couple of goals. Regardless of bye he is a must have.

Petracca backed up his comeback game last week with a 28 disposal game as he led the Suns in contested possessions and clearances. He didn't hit that big BE so dropped but his new BE of 115 means you could get him back if you want him.
Petracca returned and was on point straight away. 3 goals the result of his 25 disposals. If you traded him out then you may want to wait another week though as his BE is up to 150.
This was not what we wanted to see. A hamstring for Petracca in the 3rd quarter will see him miss 4-6 weeks. That is a bit too long to hold him so trading will be needed.

Petracca backed up his big first game for the Suns with 4 goals from 23 disposals. He simply dominated yet again and if you were one of the 24% that didn't start with him you should look at how you can get him in.
Lock and load. Petracca was massive posting a huge score in his Suns debut as he controlled the midfield. Will be in nearly every team.
